command:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/fred-omega-reg.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
branch='chatgpt/fred-omega-world-brain-convergence-20260913'
expected='ed3cdb0a9a3840ba884c24003f6831111db46192'
git clone --quiet --branch "$branch" --single-branch https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$root/repo"
cd "$root/repo"
head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo SOURCE_HEAD=$head
[ "$head" = "$expected" ] || { echo HEAD_DRIFT; exit 40; }
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

def replace(path, old, new, count=None):
    p=Path(path); s=p.read_text()
    n=s.count(old)
    if count is not None and n != count:
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: expected {count} occurrences, got {n}: {old!r}')
    if n == 0:
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: missing replacement anchor: {old!r}')
    p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))

replace('scripts/omega_world_turn.py',
        'import omega_externalized_cognition as externalized\n',
        'import omega_externalized_cognition as externalized\nimport omega_cognitive_regulation as regulation\n', 1)
replace('scripts/omega_world_turn.py',
        '        cognition = externalized.build_cycle(\n',
        '        cognition = regulation.build_full_cycle(\n', 1)
replace('scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh',
        '  omega_externalized_cognition.py\n',
        '  omega_externalized_cognition.py\n  omega_cognitive_regulation.py\n', 1)

# Workflow has this anchor in PR paths, push paths and executable command.
replace('.github/workflows/omega-native-world-model.yml',
        '          scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py\n',
        '          scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py\n          scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py\n', 1)
replace('.github/workflows/omega-native-world-model.yml',
        "      - 'scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py'\n",
        "      - 'scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py'\n      - 'scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py'\n", 2)
replace('.github/workflows/omega-native-world-model.yml',
        '          tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py\n',
        '          tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py\n          tests/test_omega_cognitive_regulation.py\n', 1)
replace('.github/workflows/omega-native-world-model.yml',
        "      - 'tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py'\n",
        "      - 'tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py'\n      - 'tests/test_omega_cognitive_regulation.py'\n", 2)

# Make both externalized cognition and its regulation layer first-class OMEGA organs.
p=Path('scripts/omega_runtime.py'); s=p.read_text()
anchor='''    "grid": {\n        "path": "scripts/f2wp1207_grid10_turn_loop.py",\n        "role": "canonical GRID10 transaction/reentry/competition lifecycle",\n    },\n'''.replace('\\n','\n')
insert=anchor + '''    "externalized_cognition": {\n        "path": "scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py",\n        "role": "typed micro-cognition, cognitive state and dynamic context compilation",\n    },\n    "cognitive_regulation": {\n        "path": "scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py",\n        "role": "module/concept ecology, CEV credit, manifestation and slow-consolidation gates",\n    },\n'''.replace('\\n','\n')
if s.count(anchor)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'omega_runtime grid anchor count={s.count(anchor)}')
s=s.replace(anchor,insert)
old='''PURE_COGNITION_ORGANS = (\n    "world_state",'''.replace('\\n','\n')
new='''PURE_COGNITION_ORGANS = (\n    "externalized_cognition",\n    "cognitive_regulation",\n    "world_state",'''.replace('\\n','\n')
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('omega_runtime PURE_COGNITION anchor mismatch')
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''        "world_brain_path": [\n            "world_state",'''.replace('\\n','\n')
new='''        "world_brain_path": [\n            "world_state",\n            "externalized_cognition",\n            "cognitive_regulation",'''.replace('\\n','\n')
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('omega_runtime world_brain_path anchor mismatch')
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py scripts/omega_world_turn.py scripts/omega_voice_world_patch.py scripts/omega_runtime.py scripts/voice_full_runtime.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py tests/test_omega_cognitive_regulation.py tests/test_omega_runtime.py tests/test_omega_grf_turn_forensics.py tests/test_omega_world_model.py tests/test_omega_world_reentry_coupling.py tests/test_omega_world_donor_frankenstein.py tests/test_omega_world_agentzero_hybrid.py tests/test_omega_world_brain_convergence.py tests/test_omega_grf_field_convergence.py tests/test_omega_world_turn.py tests/test_omega_voice_world_patch_contract.py tests/test_omega_voice_world_patch_semantics.py
git diff --check
git status --short
git add scripts/omega_world_turn.py scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh scripts/omega_runtime.py .github/workflows/omega-native-world-model.yml
git commit -m 'FRED: wire externalized regulation into canonical OMEGA turn'
git push origin HEAD:"$branch"
echo NEW_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo OMEGA_REGULATION_WIRE_TEST_PASS
